Joining Team Rocket === After defeating the five trainers on Nugget Bridge, Team Rocket Elvis will try to recruit the player. Joining Team Rocket will allow the player to start several [[Quests|missions]] at Team Rocket's Headquarters in [[Cerulean City]]. If the player refuses to join they can return and speak to him again, up until they have defeated {{Gym|8}}. Initially refusing to join will raise the player's [[Karma]] by 5, while joining will lower the player's Karma by 5. ===Field Research Quest=== After fusing 5 Pokemon and talking to Professor Oak's aide in the Cerulean City Pokemon Center, she appears standing in the grass on the left. She’s looking for Abras on this route, so run around in the grass to find and catch one. For showing the assistant an Abra, she’ll give you the [[Pokéradar]].
